title: Kufe ke yateemo ko
body:
MAULA KO JO DAFNA KAR HASSNAIN PALAT AAYE.
THAHR RAAYI ZAMEE,N KAANPA FALAK SHOUREY FUGHA,N SE.
ITNE ME HAR EK SIMTH SE AAWAAZ A AAYI.
KOOFE KE YATEEMO KO YAAD AATI HAI HYDER KI..
Koofe ke yateemo Ko yaad aati hai hyder ki.
Lachaar ghareebo Ko yaad aati hai hyder ki.
1)Ghar jaake yateemo Ko haatho se khila the they.
Ehsaas yateemi ka hone nhin de the they..............
Un ghamzada bachho Ko yaad aati hai hyder ki......
kufe ke yatemoon ko yaad aati hai haider ki (2)
2)Padhti hai nazar jab bhi mehraabe ibadath par...
Tab masjide koofa ka.... aata nazar manzar.........
Sab sajda guzaaro Ko... yaad aati hai hyder ki....
kufe ke yatemoon ko yaad aati hai haider ki(2)
3)Dafna k koyi apni zaoja jo aathe hain.................
Thanhaayi k jab unko..... lamhaath satha the hain
Un dard k maaro Ko yaad aati hai hyder ki................
kufe ke yatemoon ko yaad aati hai haider ki(2)
4)Maula ki shahadath ki jis waqt qabar phaili.............
Uswaqt falak kaanpa...... paiham a sada aayi........
Ham arsh nasheeno Ko yaad aati hai hyder ki.....
kufe ke yatemoon ko yaad aati hai haider ki(2)
5)Dafna k Ali Ko jab... hasnain chale aayee
Famayay payambar ne firdous me zehra se.....
Ab tere yateemo Ko yaad aati hai hyder ki..............
kufe ke yatemoon ko yaad aati hai haider ki(2)
6)Wannees wi,n ramza,n ki aalam pa qayamath hai.
Maulaye do aalam ki.... tareeqey shahadath hai.
Sajdo,n ki musallo,n Ko yaad aati hai hyder ki...
kufe ke yatemoon ko yaad aati hai haider ki (2)
7)Aati hai nazar jab bhi..... Wannees wi,n
ramza,n ki
Jab goonjthi hai ghaazi a
waaz azaano ki..........
Masjid k minaaro Ko yaad aati hai hyder ki..
kufe ke yatemoon ko yaad aati hai haider ki(2)
